name: dicas-da-juju
description: Site institucional de receitas publicado com Docker e Nginx

scripts.validate:compose: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const YAML=require('yaml'); const data=YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync('docker-compose.yml','utf8')); if(!data.services?.app||!data.services?.nginx) throw new Error('Servicos app ou nginx ausentes'); console.log('docker-compose.yml valido com app e nginx');"
